# 🛰️ StationSMP  🌕
## About

A Cozy Vanilla+ Modpack for the StationSMP Minecraft server featuring create and create adjecent mods to spice up the vanilla survival experince.

Create with addons focused on balance ⚙️

CC:tweaked with modifed recipes 💾

Lots of QOL mods 🚀
